speaker: Michael A. Dunn
title: The Ninety and Ten
summary: Elder Dunn teaches that Jesus Christ carries our burdens, often quietly and unseen, and that He rescues us not by shortening our course but by helping us lengthen our stride. His main story is a 100-mile ultramarathon where, at mile 90, his friend Ted promised to get him to the finish and, as a photo later showed, secretly carried his water bottles and pack for the last 10 miles. He asks those at their own "mile 90" to keep asking for help, to trust that feeling broken is not being abandoned, and to lay aside every weight and run with patience.
